newsitem.title: JAPAN: China changes Daqing price formula - Tokyo traders.
newsitem.headline: China changes Daqing price formula - Tokyo traders.

text.p: China has changed its monthly crude price formula for Daqing crude to better reflect current market conditions, traders said on Monday.
Under the new formula, effective from January prices, the price of Daqing is based on the average of Indonesia's official prices for Minas and Cinta crudes, traders said.
It no longer takes into account spot market prices of the two Indonesian grades, they said.
China reviews its price formula on an annual basis.
However, the formula has not been changed in recent years, and was becoming slightly out of date, traders said.
The price of China's Daqing crude oil for January lifting to Japanese customers has been calculated at $23.74 per barrel, up $1.14 from December, traders said earlier on Monday.
